description: Source code for a Windows-specific utility that loads a DLL, inspects its import dependencies, and prints them. Includes functions for error handling, dependency extraction, and command-line interface.

methods.name: getLastErrorString
methods.description: Retrieves the last error message as a string using Windows API.

methods.name: getDependencies
methods.description: Extracts and returns a map of dependency DLL names and their paths for a given module handle.

methods.name: printDependencies
methods.description: Loads a DLL, retrieves its dependencies, and prints each dependency and its path.

methods.name: printUsage
methods.description: Prints usage information for the command-line utility.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that processes command-line arguments and calls printDependencies for each file.
